title: Abbas ka matam hai wafadar ka
body:
Abbas ka maatam hai wafadar ka maatam
Hai fouje hussaini ke alamdar ka maatam
maare gaye maqtal me kate nehr pa shaane
karte hai haram sheh ke alamdar ka maatam
<<DIVIDER>>
teero'n se chidi mashq jo laaye hai shahedee'n
maasomo me barpa hai alamdar maatam
Hai qaide musibat me behen betiya'n saari
ab koun kare sayyade abraar ka maatam
<<DIVIDER>>
Rote the ghareebi pa jo beemaar ke chaale
zanjeer bhi khud karti beemaar ka maatam
Paamaal umeeedei'n hui aur aas bhi tooti
zainab ne kiya sheh ke wafadaar ka maatam
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba ko rote rote jo qamosh ho gayi
syedaaniya karti thi wo ghamquar ka maatam
